summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of 'The Fittest' (Phase-1) on ATHLETE and ADMIN. All 13 acceptance criteria PASS. Athlete: home card visible, /athlete/the-fittest page loads with my-score/my-rank/tab bar; filter chips work; Publish disabled without photo (NO-PHOTO rule); Lucas (has training today) publishing a training_checkin with photo → success, score 0→1, first post shows +1 badge, points_awarded=1; DEDUPE verified (second publish keeps score at 1); Pedro (no training today) publishes with photo → post created, score stays 0, no +1 badge; reactions (emoji picker) and comments (add/send) both work and update counts; Leaderboard tab lists all 16 athletes combined (both teams), the logged-in athlete row highlighted with '(You)'. Admin: /staff → menu → the-fittest-admin-nav-btn navigates to /staff/the-fittest; 5 tabs present (Overview, Challenges, Feed, Ranking, Reports [data-testid=admin-tab-reported]); Overview stat cards (Participants=16, Posts today=3, Training pts=1) and Top10 render correctly; New Challenge form saves 'TEST_ Auto Challenge' and appears in Challenges list; Feed moderation Hide→prompt reason→200 OK, post removed (3→2); Finish Challenge fires POST /admin/challenges/{id}/finish 200 and shows winner toast 'Winner: Lucas Silva (1 pts)', challenge status becomes 'finished'. 0 console errors during flows.

minor.issue: Rejects very small PNGs (10x10) with HTTP 400 'Could not process image' — likely PIL/thumbnail path. Not a real product bug (real photos are always > threshold) but consider returning a clearer message like 'Image is too small (min 128px)'.

integration_issues.issue: InstallAppModal (PWA banner) overlays the-fittest-home-card and can block a plain click; testing had to pre-set localStorage['bl_install_modal_dismissed']='true' or press 'Got it' first. Not a bug per se, just UX friction for the very first visit.

Eligibility hint text expected to explicitly say 'No training logged today' but was not found in the modal text for Pedro when checked (post-scoring correctly returned 0 pts). Worth confirming GET /api/fittest/eligibility returns has_training_today=false for pedro.santos today; if it does, the hint copy is fine, if not then the eligibility endpoint may be misclassifying.

action_items: Verify /api/fittest/eligibility returns has_training_today=false for pedro.santos@email.com so the modal shows the '• No training logged today yet' hint.
Consider dismissing the PWA install modal automatically once during a session so a first-tap on 'The Fittest' card is not intercepted.
critical_code_review_comments: the_fittest_routes.py:456 raises 400 'Could not process image' when _make_lowres returns None — return a clearer HTTP 415/422 with a min-size hint to help clients diagnose.

TheFittestAdmin.js: the Reports tab uses data-testid='admin-tab-reported' while the review request calls it 'Reports'. Consider renaming to 'admin-tab-reports' for consistency (label already says 'Reports').

TheFittest.js:79 fires POST /fittest/mark-viewed inside the initial useEffect on every mount — this is fine but should be guarded to only fire when there is an active challenge (currently fires even when challenge=null).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI test-ids match the review request. Admin 'Reports' tab is data-testid='admin-tab-reported' (not 'admin-tab-reports'). If retesting, remember The Fittest Camp Challenge is now 'finished' — either create a fresh active one via 'new-challenge-btn' or select 'TEST_ Auto Challenge · active' from challenge-selector (already exists from this run). Use a real-sized JPG (~600x400) for photo upload; the 10x10 PNG path returns 400. To bypass the PWA install modal in Playwright, execute localStorage.setItem('bl_install_modal_dismissed','true') before login or click 'Got it'.
